title: Join the WGI governance weight onto the supply fact with the spec'd clamp formula
description: Compute WGIᶜ per country from silver_wgi using the spec'd formula and join it onto the supply fact, measuring and surfacing country coverage rather than dropping unmatched countries.
acceptanceCriteria: WGIᶜ = clamp((2.5 − mean₆(WGI estimates for c, latest year available)) / 5, 0, 1), exactly as spec'd in § Business Logic & Calculations → Supply Risk.
Rescaling uses the FIXED −2.5..+2.5 bounds, never the observed min/max of the loaded set — a test asserts that adding a new country does not change any existing country's weight.

The inversion is verified directionally: a well-governed country produces a weight near 0 and a poorly-governed one near 1. A test pins this, because an un-inverted index still computes and still looks plausible while ranking every material backwards.
The mean is over all six WGI dimensions; a country with fewer than six available dimensions is handled explicitly (documented rule, not an accidental partial mean).
Join coverage is measured and unmapped countries surfaced via the existing check_unmapped mechanism, not silently dropped.
src/transformations/supply_risk.py holds the reference implementation and tests/test_supply_risk.py pins notebook-vs-src parity, per DEC-002.
notes: CREATED 2026-07-29 by /breakdown task-038 (parent difficulty 7). Seams follow the parent's proposed breakdown, re-cut against the spec as amended 2026-07-29 (§ Business Logic & Calculations → Supply Risk, and § Data Architecture → fact_supply_share). Parent ACs were written 2026-07-19 and predate that amendment — the criteria below supersede them where they differ.
SEAM (c). This subtask creates the src/ mirror the whole supply-risk path will share — 038_4 extends it.
The clamp and the fixed bounds were decided in the 2026-07-29 spec amendment specifically for reproducibility; criterion 2 is the regression test for that decision, not a nicety.

DEC-002 PARITY OBLIGATION: src/transformations is the reference implementation guarded by parity tests (tests/ loads the notebook's own functions via load_notebook_functions and pins them against the src/ version). Changing notebook logic without the mirror fails CI by design. The parent task's files_affected omitted src/ and tests/ entirely — that omission is corrected in these subtasks.

LOCAL TEST SETUP: build the SparkSession with .config('spark.sql.ansi.enabled','false') — local pyspark 4.0.1 defaults ANSI on, Fabric defaults it off, and cast semantics diverge in the dangerous direction (local raises where Fabric silently nulls). See root CLAUDE.md § Gotchas.

IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-30. Four functions (wgi_weight_expr, compute_wgi_weight, map_wgi_weight_to_country_key, attach_wgi_weight) added as top-level FunctionDefs in silver-to-gold2 and mirrored in src/transformations/supply_risk.py; the join lands between the task-038_2 additivity report and write_tbl, so the written fact carries wgi_year + wgi_weight. 41 tests in tests/test_supply_risk.py (7 parity); full suite 189 passed.

CRITERION 2 DESIGN: the -2.5/+2.5 bounds are function DEFAULTS, not module constants — deliberate, because the parity harness compiles notebook FunctionDefs in a fresh namespace, so a constant read from enclosing scope would be supplied by the test and a drifted notebook value would go undetected.

CRITERION 4 RULE (see DEC-009): WGI-c uses the latest year in which a country carries ALL SIX dimensions, falling back to an older complete vintage; NULL when no complete year exists — never a partial mean. This DELIBERATELY differs from create_data_gaps_table's coverage flag (six distinct indicators across ANY years), which answers a different question; the divergence is documented in both implementations and the coverage rule was left unmodified.

HAZARD FOUND AND FIXED MID-IMPLEMENTATION: F.greatest/F.least IGNORE nulls and return the greatest non-null argument, so a bare least(greatest(raw,0),1) maps a NULL mean to 0.0 — 'perfect governance' for a country with no data, indistinguishable downstream from a real weight. An F.when(isNotNull) wrapper is the fix; two tests pin it.

MUTATION-TESTED as positive controls (a passing assertion proves nothing about its ability to fail): drifting src estimate_max to 2.4 failed 9 assertions across 3 classes; removing the inversion from the NOTEBOOK ONLY failed 7 parity assertions (0.2 vs 0.8). Both reverted and re-verified green.

⚠️ FOR ERIK (owner: both) — this dispatch was LOCAL AUTHORING ONLY. The pipeline must run in Fabric to land wgi_year + wgi_weight. The run's console output is the acceptance evidence for the criterion-5 coverage report and the WGI-c vintage table.

OPEN (non-blocking, FR-038): fabric/oem_wh.Warehouse/dbo/Tables/fact_supply_share.sql is now THREE columns behind the lakehouse table (supply_mix + t from task-038_2, wgi_year + wgi_weight from this task). Separate Fabric Warehouse item, not the Delta table gold writes — left alone deliberately, candidate for its own task.

FILES_AFFECTED WIDENED 2026-07-30: .claude/support/documents/schemas/gold_tables.md was modified (it still asserted the pre-task-038_2 four-column grain). FR-037 + a template_gap marker record that schema-changing tasks keep under-declaring the state-asserting schema docs.

CONSUMER SWEEP CLEAN: no consumer uses SELECT * against the fact; the only wildcard reads are v_fact_supply_share_high_confidence and v_fact_supply_share_complete (fs.*) inside the same notebook, rebuilt after the write, so they simply gain the two columns with no name collision. Checked silver-to-gold2 + 4 downstream readers, data_quality_checks, data_quality_analysis, create_quality_views.sql, dax/quality_measures.dax, the v2 TMDL, the Warehouse DDL, bronze-to-silver, all of src/ and tests/, and 11 referencing docs.

VERIFICATION PASS attempt 1 (2026-07-30), 0 major / 4 minor. All four minors were FIXED 2026-07-31 rather than accepted, because each was a statement this task's own change had made false: (1) check_unmapped's docstring claimed 'no callsite in this notebook' — task-038_3 gave it one, so the docstring now records the callsite history instead (a stale 'no consumer' claim is exactly what a retirement audit trips on); (2)+(3) the coverage-rule NOTE now points at DEC-009 and says explicitly the two rules must NOT be reconciled by weakening either; (4) the consumer-sweep note named v_fact_supply_share_quality — the view is v_fact_supply_share_high_confidence. Line-number cross-refs (~L2700/~L2688) were replaced with SYMBOL references rather than corrected numbers, since they had gone stale by exactly the 269 lines this task inserted and would go stale again on the next edit.

LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-07-31 via the SQL analytics endpoint (Playwright, 3 queries). Erik ran silver-to-gold2 standalone after a git-panel Update; workspace item read Synced. The wgi_year + wgi_weight columns resolved on the endpoint IMMEDIATELY this time — no repeat of task-038_2's ~7h endpoint schema lag.

CRITERION 3 (inversion direction) CONFIRMED ON REAL WORLD BANK DATA, all wgi_year=2023: DNK 0.130, FIN 0.151, NOR 0.155, SWE 0.182, DEU 0.219 | CHN 0.552, RUS 0.673, ZWE 0.729, COD 0.804, MMR 0.836, AFG 0.868. Monotonic and correctly oriented (1 = worst governance), and inside the 0.1-0.3 / 0.7-0.9 bands the test protocol predicted.

CRITERION 5 (coverage) CONFIRMED: global 2,560 rows / 11 NULL, eu_sourcing 903 rows / 7 NULL — 18 of 3,463 (0.52%), so 99.5% coverage. Global row count 2,560 is UNCHANGED from task-038_2's baseline, which independently proves the WGI join was row-preserving. Weight range 0.130-0.883, strictly inside 0..1 — the clamp holds and nothing is pinned at exactly 0, which would have been the signature of the F.greatest/F.least NULL bug.

⚠️ THE ENTIRE REAL-COUNTRY GAP IS TAIWAN. The 18 NULLs are exactly two countries: TWN Taiwan (is_placeholder=0, 14 rows, 19.40 summed share_pct) and UNK_GLOB 'Unknown - Global' (is_placeholder=1, 4 rows, 85.00). Taiwan is NOT an aliasing failure and is NOT remediable — the World Bank does not publish WGI for Taiwan (not a member), so no vintage will ever exist. UNK_GLOB is the placeholder bucket and is correctly NULL.

CONSEQUENCE FOR task-038_4: Taiwan carries real supply share (19.4 share points across 14 rows) but no governance weight, so HHI_WGI,t will UNDERSTATE risk for any material where Taiwan is a significant supplier unless the NULL is handled deliberately. Per DEC-009 a NULL means 'no complete governance vintage', never 'perfectly governed' — 038_4 must not let it coerce to 0. Decide explicitly: exclude Taiwan's share from the index denominator, or impute, or report the index as partial for affected materials.

CONSEQUENCE FOR task-038_6: the report framing must disclose Taiwan's absence from the governance weighting alongside the existing 'gross supply risk' caveat — Taiwan is a material supplier in this dataset, so a silent omission would misstate the headline figure.

GUIDED TESTING COMPLETE 2026-07-31 — all 5 test_protocol steps satisfied from the data itself (columns present with values proves no hard stop and no truncation; global=2,560 unchanged proves the row-count guard held). user_review_pending cleared.

steps.instruction: Run the silver-to-gold2 notebook (or /run-full-pipeline). Watch for an early hard stop.
steps.expected: NO RuntimeError mentioning 'silver_wgi is missing ...'. If that fires, silver_wgi is still the retired 3-column shape and bronze-to-silver must be re-run first — that is a deliberate hard stop, not a bug.

steps.instruction: Confirm the row-count guard did not trip.
steps.expected: No AssertionError containing 'WGI join changed fact_supply_share row count' and none containing 'WGI weight is not unique on country_key'. The LEFT join must be row-preserving.

steps.instruction: Read the WGI coverage line (criterion 5 evidence).
steps.expected: Either 'WGI coverage: all N supply rows carry a governance weight.' or 'WGI coverage gap: N of M supply rows have no governance weight (P on placeholder countries — not remediable by aliasing; Q on real countries)' followed by a table of countries by supply share at risk. A non-zero gap is acceptable and expected for placeholder countries; report the split back.

steps.instruction: Read the 'WGIc vintages in use' table and sanity-check the direction on REAL data — the criterion-3 check unit tests can only pin synthetically.
steps.expected: min_weight/max_weight all within 0..1. Spot-check two countries: a well-governed one (NOR/SWE/DEU) must carry a LOW wgi_weight (~0.1-0.3) and a poorly-governed one (COD/AFG) a HIGH one (~0.7-0.9). If inverted, STOP — every material would rank backwards.

steps.instruction: Confirm the written table gained the two columns.
steps.expected: fact_supply_share carries wgi_year (nullable INTEGER) and wgi_weight (nullable DOUBLE, 0-1) alongside task-038_2's supply_mix + t. Verify in a NOTEBOOK, not the SQL analytics endpoint — the endpoint lagged a column addition ~7h on task-038_2.
